title: Williams Mill Visual Arts Centre

services.name: Studio Rental
services.desc: Located one hour from downtown Toronto, in the quaint Hamlet of Glen Williams, our studio spaces offer a prime location for visitor traffic. For the past 30 years the heritage site of the Williams Mill has been home to artists and artisans. Visitors are invited year-round to come and watch professional artists at work and to buy their creations. Beyond the 20 artists at Williams Mill, local amenities include restaurants, hiking trails, riverside parks, antiques, and cafés. The Williams Mill invites applications from established artists who have either formal training in their media, or a track record of acceptance in their field.
